title: Second Day of US-Mediated Russia-Ukraine Talks in Abu Dhabi: Zelensky Calls Meeting 'Constructive'
detail: Russia and Ukraine held a second day of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi. Zelensky called the meeting 'constructive, quite substantive', while Le Monde reported little progress, per France 24's live coverage.

title: Russia and Ukraine Agree in Principle to Large-Scale Prisoner Swap at US-Brokered Abu Dhabi Talks
detail: Russia and Ukraine agreed in principle to a large-scale prisoner swap after US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi; Ukraine reported 'huge progress'.

media.caption: Russia and Ukraine agree to prisoner swap at US-brokered talks
